thread:
jess_sales: Hi team — Nimbus (POC) just asked for our latest SOC 2 Type II report and wants confirmation if a bridge letter/NDA will suffice for procurement to move forward. They also asked for any redacted audit evidence we can share. Can we sync on what we can provide quickly?

omar_se: Thanks Jess. Quick context — POC will run on Dedicated for first 30 days, then could go Private. Nimbus is asking for SOC 2 to meet vendor risk. They also want response to a few SIG/CAIQ controls.

tala_security: We have a standard bridge letter we can sign that confirms coverage dates and scope for the SOC 2. It doesn't replace the report but often unblocks procurement for short-term POCs. We can also provide redacted control narratives and a table of third-party attestations.

linda_legal: @tala_security, we need to confirm whether the bridge letter requires customer signature or just our execs. Our template is usually unilateral (from Redwood) and fine for most vendors. If Nimbus insists on mutual language, that triggers legal review (~2 business days). If they want an NDA first, we can fast-track mutual NDA via DocuSign using the standard mutual NDA link below.

andrew_sre: For evidence, we can provide: architecture diagram, encryption-at-rest details, KMS key ownership, SOC 2 scope list, and a sample penetration test summary. We cannot share raw logs or full audit workpapers. If they need access to the secure portal, we can provision read-only access for their security reviewer for 72 hours — requires NDA + SSO assertion.

nimbus_cto: Thanks. A couple clarifying Qs from our side: 1) What are the SOC 2 report dates (period covered)? 2) Does the bridge letter cover Dedicated and Private deployments? 3) Is there a short checklist we can run against SIG CAIQ?

jess_sales: Good questions. Tala — can you reply inline? Also if we can give a short CAIQ checklist it might speed review.

tala_security: Answers: 1) Latest SOC 2 Type II covers 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31 (signed Q1 2025). 2) Bridge letter can state that controls apply to our hosted and dedicated fleets; private (customer-managed on-prem) is out of scope unless under a specific Private agreement and attestation. We'll add language that Dedicated is covered and Private is subject to a separate engagement. 3) I'll carve out a 1-page CAIQ-lite checklist focusing on the high-risk items they care about (auth, encryption, incident response, change mgmt, third-party mgmt).

linda_legal: For NDA: share this link to the mutual NDA (short form): https://redwood.example/docusign/mutual-nda. If they sign, we can immediately provision the portal access. If they prefer our unilateral bridge letter only, legal needs to review the wording to confirm no liability exposure — should be same day.

omar_se: For POC ops: provisioning read-only portal access flow: 1) NDA executed 2) create support ticket with nimbus reviewer email 3) SSO assertion + 72h link created. I'll own the ticket once NDA is attached.

andrew_sre: Note on evidence we can share in portal: sample config snapshots, key rotation schedule, SOC 2 cover page and summary, and redacted control narratives. We will not share employee PII or raw audit logs.

jess_sales: Timeline suggestion to Nimbus: if NDA signed today, we can send bridge letter + portal link within 24 hours, and CAIQ-lite within 48 hours. Does that work?

nimbus_cto: That timeline is great. One ask: can the bridge letter explicitly state the control owner contact for incident response? We need a contact for our cyber team.

tala_security: Yes — we'll add a single point of contact (security@redwood.ai) and phone escalation for high-sev incidents.

linda_legal: Also noting — if Nimbus wants the bridge letter to be countersigned, please flag and I'll start the 48-hour review sprint.

jess_sales: I'll send the NDA link to Nimbus and ask them to confirm reviewer email. Thanks all — I'll update this thread when NDA is signed. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: ASSET-AUDIT: SOC2-summary.pdf (redacted) uploaded to secure portal ID 9b3f. Visibility: internal only.

omar_se: Received. Once we have NDA signed, I'll open ticket to provision 'nimbus.security@corp.nimbus.com'.

nimbus_cto: NDA signed and uploaded (DocuSign ID 0a9f). Please proceed with portal access.

andrew_sre: Ticket opened: #POC-4728 — provisioning read-only portal access for nimbus.security@corp.nimbus.com for 72h. ETA 2 hours.

jess_sales: Wonderful — closing loop. If anything else pops up, ping me.

tala_security: Posting CAIQ-lite checklist here (short):
```
- Identity & Access: SSO + 2FA required for all accounts
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit
- Key Management: Customer-managed KMS supported for Dedicated
- IR: 24/7 incident team, SLA for notification 72 hours for material incidents
- Change Mgmt: PR review, staging rollout, canary deploys for model updates
```

linda_legal: Filing note — mutual NDA DocuSign reference attached to deal record.

jess_sales: Thanks everyone. Nimbus is unblocked for initial POC buy-in.
